agent.title: Connect my AI
agent.description: Add Runbase to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor or Codex in two minutes. Your AI then builds and runs everything for you.

template.title: Start from a template, or ask your AI
template.description: Pick a ready-made CRM, support inbox or onboarding tracker below, or ask your AI to build exactly what you need.
template.descriptionMember: Ask your AI to build what you need. Templates are installed by an admin.

change.title: Make a change by asking your AI
change.description: Ask your AI to add a field, a step or a page. It updates your workspace for you.
change.example: Add a "Next follow-up" date to my leads and remind me on Slack the day before.

team.title: Invite your team
team.description: Share what you built with the people who use it every day.

connected.title: Your AI is connected
connected.prompts: Try one of these first requests:

prompts.crm: Build me a CRM to track my leads: Leads, Companies and a Pipeline page
prompts.slack: Every morning, send me on Slack the new leads with a high score
prompts.csv: Import this CSV of contacts and remove duplicates

globalError.title: The app ran into a problem
globalError.description: Nothing is lost. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, contact your administrator.

notFound.title: Page not found
